text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Pager fired for service=edge-canary (edge-proxy). Metric: 5xx_rate spike from 0.3% -> 12% in last 2m. Threshold: 5%

sre-oncall: acked the page, I'm on it. pulling logs and rolling back canary if needed. @eng-release do we have a recent roll?

eng-release: deploying v2026.03.11-canary 10m ago. only ~5% of traffic. no config changes since smoke.

alex: seeing a pattern: backend rereranker returning 502/503 for requests with embedding payloads > 2k tokens. dumping sample traces now.

sam-eng: typo in release script? nothing obvious in deploy logs. metrics show latency + errors only on edge-canary nodes in eu-west1. production dedicated pools OK.

sre-oncall: pasting tail of proxy logs (filtered):

```
2026-03-15T09:12:02Z edge-proxy-12 - upstream error: POST /v1/generate -> 503 (upstream: rereranker-3) token_count=2456 ctx_id=abc123
2026-03-15T09:12:05Z edge-proxy-13 - upstream timeout: 504 (upstream: rereranker-2) token_count=1890 ctx_id=def456
2026-03-15T09:12:11Z edge-proxy-12 - upstream error: 503 (upstream: rereranker-3) token_count=2478 ctx_id=ghi789
```

alex: looks like a quantized kernel regression on rereranker-3. we've seen similar with the new quant path.

pd-bot: NOTE: Incident escalated to Team SRE -> primary oncall (sre-oncall) acknowledged. Escalation to Eng if unacked after 2m.

tanya: I'm pulling model node logs and GPU health. jumping into the pod.

eng-release: can we throttle canary traffic to 0% while we investigate? prefer graceful drain vs full rollback if possible.

sre-oncall: attempting traffic diversion to default pool for edge-canary fraction 5% -> 0% now. running: `rctl update traffic-split edge:canary=0`

alex: traffic diversion applied. error rate dropping on frontend immediately, but we need to confirm internal failures still not resurfacing when traffic returns.

sre-oncall: quick customer impact check: monitoring shows ~1.2% of global requests briefly affected; estimated ~600 customer requests failed in window. alerting CX to expect outreach from affected customers. @lucy-pm fyi.

lucy-pm: thanks. escalate to support triage and patch release comms if rollback needed.

tanya: rereranker-3 container showing repeated kernel launch failures: `cuLaunchKernel failed: invalid configuration` in logs. restarting container now.

sam-eng: restarting didn't help; the node falls back to software quant path which is slower and throws 503s under load. suspected bad kernel version in the image.

eng-release: we built new canary image with updated kernels last night. seems the image pushed to eu-west region still references the older kernel package by mistake. shipping a hotfix tag now.

sre-oncall: PD note: if engineering needs to repackage and redeploy, please coordinate min downtime. current mitigation (traffic diversion) is holding.

alex: preparing to rollback canary to previous image v2026.03.10 if hotfix can't be staged in <12m.

pd-bot: Reminder: if incident remains active >15m, escalate to PDL and SRE lead.

eng-release: hotfix image built and pushed to registry eu-west. rolling update to canary pool now: `kubectl set image deploy/edge-canary edge-proxy=registry/redwood/edge:2026.03.10-hotfix`

sre-oncall: applying update. watching healthchecks.

incident-bot: deploy-bot: rollout started for deploy/edge-canary (image: 2026.03.10-hotfix).

alex: healthchecks green on first 3 pods, 503s gone from logs. p99 latency stable.

tanya: model nodes recovered, no kernel errors after hotfix.

sre-oncall: confirming traffic re-enable: restoring canary fraction to 5%

eng-release: re-enable applied. monitoring for 5m.

alex: 5m check: no spike in 5xx, downstream services stable.

sre-oncall: incident notes: cause = incorrect kernel package variant in canary image (region-specific push). mitigation = traffic diversion -> hotfix image rollout -> gradual re-enable. customer impact = transient 1.2% failed requests (~600 requests).

lucy-pm: please add postmortem entry and impact summary for support. I'll draft comms.

sre-oncall: handing off to eng-release for followup and postmortem. @eng-release take primary. closing on-call for now. :white_check_mark:

eng-release: taking handoff. will open a postmortem draft, include timeline, root cause, and uplift to release test matrix to prevent region-image drift.

pd-bot: Incident resolved by primary. Auto-close in 30m unless reopened. :tada:
